purpose: prove that the frozen spreading instrument (seed handling, absorbing test, censoring, local-slope estimator, bracketing, tolerances, classifier) recovers known thresholds and universality classes before it is pointed at IOTA
gate_rule: Stage S (IOTA spreading) may not be opened unless every calibration model below returns its registered class and, where registered, its threshold and static exponent within tolerance; any calibration failure is a terminal instrument failure for this protocol version, recorded as such, and is repaired only in a new version
shared_instrument: estimators.json, applied without modification to every calibration model and to IOTA

models.law: Domany-Kinzel automaton with p1 = p, p2 = p(2-p) (bond directed percolation)
models.seed: single active site at the origin, all others inactive

models.law: Domany-Kinzel automaton with p1 = p2 = p (site directed percolation)
models.seed: single active site at the origin

models.law: bond directed percolation on the simple cubic spatial lattice: each active site at layer t independently activates each of its 6 face neighbours and itself at layer t+1 with probability p per bond
models.threshold_note: no verified literature threshold is registered for this exact neighbourhood; the gate is class recovery only

models.law: one-tick SIR on the simple cubic lattice: each newly infected site transmits once to each susceptible face neighbour with probability p, then becomes permanently removed
models.seed: single infected site at (32,32,32), all others susceptible
models.threshold_note: the one-tick SIR cluster is exactly a bond-percolation cluster, so its critical transmissibility is the bond threshold

models.law: breadth-first growth on a site-diluted simple cubic lattice: every non-seed site is open with probability rho, drawn once; at each generation every newly reached site reaches all of its open, unreached face neighbours; reached sites are never revisited
models.absorbing_test: no newly reached site in the generation

static_gate.quantity: tau - 2 from estimators.json static_cluster_size at the final point

models.why: this is IOTA-MIN-L0 with an unlimited budget: it explores the seed's fresh cluster completely and in chemical-distance order. It shares the medium, lattice, threshold, and static exponent that H1 to H3 compare against, so it is the exact reference that L0 departs from only through the amplitude budget and one-quantum-per-tick service

rng.seed_derivation: SHA-256 of ASCII 'ICP-DP-PERSISTENCE-001' NUL model_id NUL control value as decimal string NUL run index, first 8 bytes big-endian
rng.partition: calibration seeds are disjoint from IOTA development and confirmation seeds by domain separation
